Behind her is a logo for DRX Dermatology Clinic and a silver plaque. She gestures slightly as she introduces a topic with an engaged facial expression. (2) The scene cuts to a close-up of a patient's face while a medical professional wearing white latex gloves operates a bulky white handheld medical device against the cheek and jaw area. The background is a dark gray treatment table, and the lighting is focused on the skin, showing the mechanical application of the treatment. (3) Returning to the woman in the clinic office, she continues speaking with animated facial expressions, pointing to her jawline and neck to emphasize skin tightening effects. Various text overlays appear intermittently around her, highlighting key points about the treatment sensations and benefits. (4) A static comparison layout appears on a gray background, showing four profile shots of a person's jawline labeled with text indicators for 'Before' and 'After.' The images illustrate the physical results of the medical procedure on the submental area and lower face contour with clear visual contrast. (5) The video concludes with a clean graphic card containing the clinic's logo, social media handles, phone number, and physical addresses in Taiwan. The text is neatly arranged against a minimalist background with a stylized gray and white aesthetic to provide contact information for viewers.
